title: Completed integral pullback to a clopen is restriction of quotient completion
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell. For every scheme V and clopen open U⊆V, quotient completion on the completed integral coefficient derived category of V followed by the normalized exact open derived restriction to U is naturally isomorphic to the specified completed integral derived pullback along U→V. This is an isomorphism of functors on all unbounded complexes; no invertibility of ell on V or completeness of the input is assumed.

proof.text: Use clopenPullbackQuotientTower to identify the restriction of the global strict quotient tower with integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor, naturally on every cochain complex. Its proof checks the completed coefficient adjunction by finite projections and assembles the existing scalar quotient comparisons using their pure-tensor normalizations.

Ordinary restriction preserves countable products: after forgetting modules and sheaves, it is precomposition of presheaves, which preserves limits pointwise. The forgetful composite reflects limits. Apply the additive strict Roos comparison to obtain a natural isomorphism from restricted Roos completion to the Roos complex of the restricted tower. Reorder complexes of towers by HomologicalComplex.functorEquivalence and use strictRoosProductMap_comm for naturality.

Whisker the tower comparison through the Roos functor and compose with the preceding restriction/Roos isomorphism. On good complexes insert completionComparison and the exact functor mapDerivedCategoryFactors isomorphism. The result has exactly the comparison required by integralPullbackDescent.universal. Its unique natural isomorphism, inverted, is the asserted isomorphism of derived functors. No input completeness or prime invertibility is used.

theorem clopenIntegralCompletionRestriction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (V : Scheme.{u}) (U : V.Opens) (_hU : IsClosed (U : Set V)) :
    Nonempty (IntegralOnSlice.completion l E V none ⋙
      OpenCompletedRestriction.derivedRestriction l E U.ι ≅
        integralDerivedPullback l E U.ι)
